title.zh: Meta计划引入无投票权股票，以在不稀释扎克伯格控制权的情况下为AI提供资金
title.en: Meta计划引入无投票权股票，以在不稀释扎克伯格控制权的情况下为AI提供资金

current_state.zh: Meta plans to introduce non-voting shares so it can issue equity to fund AI acquisitions, talent, and chips without diluting Mark Zuckerberg's control, following capex guidance raised to $135–145 billion and negative free cash flow.
current_state.en: Meta plans to introduce non-voting shares so it can issue equity to fund AI acquisitions, talent, and chips without diluting Mark Zuckerberg's control, following capex guidance raised to $135–145 billion and negative free cash flow.
